properties.title: Incident Reporting Form
properties.errorMessage: Unable to submit incident. Please try again.
properties.fullNameInfo: Enter the full name of the person submitting or involved in the incident.
properties.occupationRoleInfo: Enter the job title or role of the person involved.
properties.addressOfIncidentInfo: Provide the physical address where the incident happened.
properties.locationNameOfIncidentInfo: Enter the location name, site, or department of the incident.
properties.dateOfIncidentInfo: Select the date when the incident took place.
properties.timeOfIncidentInfo: Select the time when the incident occurred.
properties.dateReportedInfo: Select the date when this incident was reported.
properties.timeReportedInfo: Select the time when this incident was reported.
properties.supervisorInfo: Enter the supervisor name associated with the incident.
properties.typeOfIncidentInfo: Choose the incident category from the dropdown list.
properties.whoWasInjuredInfo: Enter the full name of the injured person.
properties.equipmentDamagedInfo: Specify damaged equipment name if any.
properties.equipmentIdentifyingNumberInfo: Provide the equipment ID, serial, or asset number.
properties.damagedEquipmentDescriptionInfo: Describe the damage observed on the equipment.
properties.descriptionOfIncidentInfo: Describe all relevant background information, sequence of events leading to the incident, what occurred that precipitated the accident, the mechanism of accident and who did you contact after.
properties.immediateActionsTakenInfo: Describe actions done immediately after incident, such as first aid or area isolation.
properties.attachmentsInfo: Upload photos or files that support the incident details.
